title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 03/2016
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's, mics set-up on the SBD platform, recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Outstanding audience recording captures a rock‑solid 9/17/82 show with smoking Bertha, High Time and Touch of Grey.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the show’s performance – calling it “rock solid” and “exceptional” – highlighting Bertha, High Time, Touch of Grey and the GDTRFB > Morning Dew sequence. The audience tape is praised as “off the charts” and a superb transportive listening experience, making this one of the best recordings available.

ai_rating.rationale: Both 5‑star reviews describe an exceptional performance and an excellent audience recording; consistent praise gives high confidence in a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the sound is “off the charts,” “outstanding job recording,” and that the audience tape puts listeners right in the venue, indicating clear, immersive audio with no reported flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show flows tightly from start to finish with a strong first set and an especially memorable second‑set sequence, delivering constant energy.
